page.summary: After the generators finish, assign a safe rescuer and a route to the exit before committing to a late hook; endgame support is wasted if the team never reaches that state or the rescue cannot be converted.

verdict.recommendation: Check hook pressure, teammate positions and the gate route; take the rescue only when the saved player can actually leave.
verdict.soloQ: Use visible teammate positions to avoid a duplicate rescue and do not assume someone else will cover the gate.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Call one rescuer, one gate assignment and the exit path before leaving the hook area.
verdict.mainWeakness: Endgame perk slots do nothing before generator completion and a late rescue can still cost another down.

options.whyItsHere: After all generators complete, it reveals other Survivors, speeds healing and unhooking them by 80/90/100%, and adds 10% more Haste to a Survivor you unhook; it does not create an earlier rescue window.

opening: Before the last generator completes, keep contributing to the objective; this rescue package does not pay off if the gates never become powered.

rows.situation: The generators are complete and a teammate is hooked while an exit route is plausible.
rows.action: Identify the safe approach, who is opening a gate and who will escort the rescued player. If teammates are already converging, avoid duplicate travel.
rows.why: A late unhook matters only if the team can convert it into escape rather than another hook trade.

rows.situation: You can safely reach the hook after all generators are complete.
rows.action: Use the teammate auras to confirm the assignment, unhook at the workable moment, and use the faster altruistic heal only if the Killer gives you a real reset window.
rows.why: No One Left Behind improves post-generator teammate information and altruistic actions, but its added post-unhook Haste is not a guaranteed escape.

rows.situation: The route is blocked, the rescue arrives too late or the saved player cannot reach a gate.
rows.action: Stop forcing the hook approach; preserve a possible exit or return to the immediately useful team assignment.
rows.why: Further health-state and travel costs cannot recover an expired rescue window.

abortWhen: Do not take a late hook trade without a plausible exit for the rescued Survivor.
If generators never complete, keep the objective plan rather than waiting for an endgame perk to activate.

weaknesses: Value is concentrated after generator completion; coordination and a viable exit route still determine whether a rescue converts.
commonMistakes: Sending multiple Survivors to the same late hook while no one prepares the gate.
Treating faster unhooking or post-unhook Haste as proof that a contested route is safe.
